stem: 虽然信托和公司服务提供商（TCSP）有正当理由任命代名股东，但代名股东的哪一特征会带来最大的金融犯罪风险？

options.A: 提高公司股份的流动性，并便于实施退出策略
options.B: 通过将受益所有人的身份从公共登记册中隐藏起来为其提供匿名性
options.C: 简化与持股相关的行政事务
options.D: 协助非居民遵守本地所有权法规

stem_en: While there are legitimate reasons for trust and company service providers (TCSPs) to appoint a nominee shareholder, which feature of a nominee shareholder presents the greatest financial crime risk?

options_en.A: Supporting company liquidity and ease of exit strategies
options_en.B: Providing anonymity for the beneficial owner by keeping their identity hidden from the public register
options_en.C: Simplifying administrative tasks associated with shareholding
options_en.D: Helping non-residents comply with local ownership laws
